title: Mashambani, redio ya kijiji hulia saa 12:00
label: Redio ya mchana

text.This is a story from when I went to my g: Hii ni hadithi ya wakati nilipoenda nyumbani kwa bibi yangu huko Gifu.
text.What felt new to me in the countryside i: Kilichonishangaza mashambani ni kwamba redio bado hutumiwa.
text.When it turns 12:00, the village radio a: Saa inapofika 12:00, redio ya kijiji hucheza kiotomatiki “kin-kon-kan-kon.”
text.Radios in the countryside automatically: Mashambani, redio hujiwasha kiotomatiki saa 12:00 PM na kucheza kengele ya shule. 🏫🔔
text.▶️ Radios in the countryside automatical: ▶️ Mashambani, redio hujiwasha kiotomatiki saa 12:00 PM na kucheza kengele ya shule. 🏫🔔
text.When you live in a city, there is nothin: Ukiishi mjini, hakuna kitu kama “wakati huu, kila mara kuna sauti inayolia.”
Kwa hiyo, niliona ni jambo jipya.
